# Contextify contributor workflows

## Local verification
- Run core writer and drift fixtures from the repository root with `python3 tests/test_ctx_check.py`.
- Run claim resolution fixtures with `python3 tests/test_verify_claims.py` and preservation regressions with `python3 tests/test_regressions.py`.
- Run Git hook fixtures with `python3 tests/test_hooks.py` and supporting-document fixtures with `python3 tests/test_supporting_docs.py`.
- Check required files and version agreement with `python3 tests/test_manifests.py`, then the skill contract with `python3 evals/check_skill.py skills/contextify/SKILL.md`.

## Context changes
- `skills/contextify/references/update-in-place.md` defines preservation and conflict behavior; `skills/contextify/references/supporting-docs.md` defines when to create supporting docs.
- `skills/contextify/SKILL.md` requires a displayed diff and a separate source-verification pass before applying generated context.

## Publication
- `.github/workflows/validate.yml` runs checks on pushes and pull requests.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` handles version tags, checks their version against `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, and creates a GitHub release.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` skips automatic hub dispatch when its dispatch token is absent.
